meta_description: BD Plastering Manchester delivers expert plastering, skimming, and rendering. Fast, professional work. Free quotes. Call 07977 511428.
hero_subhead: Cracked walls or uneven plaster? BD Plastering transforms your interior with precision work and fast turnarounds across Greater Manchester.
services_subhead: From minor repairs to full room skimming, we handle every plastering job with skill and attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Plastering & Skimming
services.desc: Full room plaster, feature walls, and ceiling work to a smooth, professional finish. We prepare walls properly and match existing plaster textures.

services.title: Render & External Plastering
services.desc: Weather-resistant external renders and pebbledash repairs. We use quality materials and techniques to protect your home exterior.

services.title: Damp Repairs & Plaster Recovery
services.desc: Damaged plaster from damp? We treat the source, apply tanking where needed, and replaster to prevent future issues.

services.title: Patch & Repair Work
services.desc: Crack repairs, hole patching, and small wall damage fixed quickly. Ideal for landlords and homeowners between projects.

services.title: Textured & Decorative Finishes
services.desc: Artexed ceilings, Venetian finishes, and specialty wall textures applied with precision and care.

services.title: New Build & Renovation Plastering
services.desc: Full plaster specifications for extensions, loft conversions, and renovation work. We work to schedule and building regs standards.

about_pullquote: I started BD Plastering because I saw too much rushed work. We do it properly, every time.
about_para_1: BD Plastering was established over 20 years ago with a simple aim: deliver honest, high-quality plastering work at fair prices. Based in Urmston, we've built our reputation across Greater Manchester by turning up on time, listening to what our customers need, and leaving every job finished to a standard we'd be proud of in our own homes.
about_para_2: Our repeat customer rate speaks for itself — homeowners, landlords, and contractors come back because we're reliable, efficient, and we don't cut corners. Whether it's a single patch or a full house renovation, we treat every job with the same care and attention. We're insured, experienced, and always happy to provide free quotes and advice before we start.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Customers Say About BD Plastering

reviews.text: Had two rooms skimmed after fitting new windows. BD Plastering made a right mess look brilliant. Very tidy workers, finished on time, and the plaster is smooth as anything. Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Nightmare damp patch on the bedroom wall. They sorted the cause, applied the treatment, and replastered it. Six months on and no sign of it coming back. Honest blokes, fair pricing. Top job.
reviews.author: Claire P.

reviews.text: Called on a Tuesday for a free quote on our extension plaster. Started work the following Monday. Quick, professional, and the finish is perfect. Will use them again without question.
reviews.author: David S.
